mandate: C323 — test the cross-sectional intraday ORDER-FLOW & TRADE-ACTIVITY SEASONALITY mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1440 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -seasonal-dislocation, short above-baseline flow/activity / long below): ofi_dev (signed_volume/total_volume vs trailing same-tod mean), tss_dev (trade_sign_sum/trade_count vs trailing same-tod mean), tc_dev (log trade_count vs trailing same-tod mean), notional_dev (log notional vs trailing same-tod mean), ofi_ewm (ofi_ratio vs causal ewm same-tod mean). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and flow-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED zero-activity NaN policy applied (ratios/logs NaN where denominators/values <=0; NaN-aware same-tod trailing stats, min_periods=L; NaN-feature assets weight 0).

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.flow_activity: ofi_ratio=signed_volume/total_volume (NaN where total_volume==0); tss_ratio=trade_sign_sum/trade_count (NaN where trade_count==0); log_tc=log(trade_count) (NaN where trade_count<=0); log_notional=log(notional) (NaN where notional<=0). PRE-REGISTERED zero-activity NaN POLICY; NaNs only at zero-activity bars (<0.1%).
methodology.signals: ofi_dev=-(ofi_ratio-mean_L(ofi_ratio@tod)); tss_dev=-(tss_ratio-mean_L(tss_ratio@tod)); tc_dev=-(log_tc-mean_L(log_tc@tod)); notional_dev=-(log_notional-mean_L(log_notional@tod)); ofi_ewm=-(ofi_ratio-ewm_mean_L(ofi_ratio@tod)). lookback L days = trailing L seasonal occurrences, min_periods=L, NaN-aware (exclude NaN obs), fail-closed. score=-dislocation; causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-signal assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1440 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs flow_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
